confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Florianópolis and Brazilian coastal tourism pricing, not from live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are the more reliable; accommodation is less certain because July is low-season for beaches but a school-holiday period, and prices vary widely by neighbourhood. Cocktail and wine anchors are weaker, so they follow the local beer relationship. The FX observation came from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page and was not verified by opening that page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Brazil's mid-to-upper-priced coastal tourist cities in the south, such as other Santa Catarina and Paraná resort and state-capital areas, with a modest premium for Florianópolis's island tourism profile. Restaurant prices are set against typical Brazilian regional restaurant pricing; accommodation is set against the regional coastal hotel and hostel market in the shoulder/low season.
